elevate.move: Replace the inert single-frame filmstrip with a true three-frame sander-pass sequence using existing process media (process-sander, process-stain, process-finish). Stagger their clip-path reveals at 70ms on load as the concept specifies. This delivers the promised intro moment, adds a third motion hook above the >=3 threshold, and makes the first screen's signature visible rather than structural-only.

Break the services grid monotony by threading the grit-rail signature through it. Assign each service card a grit number based on its place in the refinishing sequence (Sand & refinish = 36, Screen & recoat = 100, Stain samples = STAIN, etc.). Render the grit pill inside each card and let the rail animate across the section header. This turns a template grid into a signature-bearing section and lifts distinctiveness alongside layout.
